tools.name: audit_accessibility
tools.description: Audits a Figma frame for WCAG 2.1 accessibility issues: contrast ratios, touch targets, missing alt text, font sizes. Returns issues with severity levels and an overall accessibility score.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (from the file URL)

node_id.description: The frame node ID to audit

tools.name: bridge_to_codebase
tools.description: Scans Figma components and a local codebase, then maps component names to likely implementation files using exact, case-insensitive, and partial filename matching.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (from the file URL)

project_path.description: Local project path to scan for matching component files

tools.name: diff_versions
tools.description: Fetches two Figma file versions and reports added, removed, and modified nodes by comparing names, types, geometry, fills, and style properties.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (from the file URL)

tools.name: export_images
tools.description: Exports Figma nodes as images (PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF) via the Figma image export API. Returns download URLs for each requested node.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (from the file URL)

node_ids.description: Array of node IDs to export

tools.name: extract_design_tokens
tools.description: Extracts all design tokens (colors, typography, spacing) from a Figma file and exports them in your chosen format: CSS custom properties (DTCG-aligned), Style Dictionary JSON, or Tailwind config. Spacing tokens are sourced from auto-layout padding and gap values. Each token includes source node IDs for traceability.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (from the file URL)

export_format.description: Output format for the exported tokens

tools.name: extract_flows
tools.description: Extracts prototype flows from a page or frame by finding transition links in the node tree, then returns directed frame-to-frame connections and a deterministic traversal order.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (from the file URL)

node_id.description: The page or top-level frame node ID to scan for flows

tools.name: extract_variants
tools.description: Reads a Figma component set and returns structured variant data including parsed variant properties, dimensions, layout details, fills, and typography from text descendants.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (from the file URL)

node_id.description: The COMPONENT_SET node ID to inspect

tools.name: inspect_layout
tools.description: Inspects a Figma frame and returns deterministic layout data: node hierarchy, auto-layout vs absolute positioning, spacing, padding, constraints, and accessibility warnings (touch targets, font sizes). Output is a versioned JSON envelope — stable and predictable for downstream tooling.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (from the file URL)

node_id.description: The node ID of the frame to inspect

tools.name: map_to_unity
tools.description: Produces a Unity UGUI mapping spec from a Figma frame. Maps Figma constraints to RectTransform anchors, auto-layout to HorizontalLayoutGroup/VerticalLayoutGroup, and suggests appropriate Unity components per node type. Includes confidence scores for inferred components and warnings for unknown constraints or unsupported effects.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (from the file URL)

node_id.description: The node ID of the frame to produce a Unity mapping spec for

canvas_width.description: Target Unity canvas width in pixels

canvas_height.description: Target Unity canvas height in pixels

tools.name: resolve_components
tools.description: Scans a Figma subtree or full file for instances, resolves each unique component through the file component map and Figma component API, and returns the source file and node for each instance.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (from the file URL)

node_id.description: Optional node ID to limit the scan to a subtree

tools.name: simplify_context
tools.description: Produces an AI-optimized, token-efficient representation of a Figma frame. Strips noise, collapses wrappers, groups repeated elements, and truncates deep hierarchies. Designed to fit within LLM context windows.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (from the file URL)

node_id.description: The frame node ID to simplify
